pages.text: An Extract side starts at 30 ticks between operations. Every operation that moves something makes it 2 ticks faster (down to 5); every one that moves nothing doubles the wait (up to 100).$(br2)A side with no target sleeps and costs nothing until its network changes.
All numbers are in the server config. The side screen's header shows what the side is doing: Working, Asleep, Waiting, Stuck or Idle.
